verdict.rationale: n8n documents a centralized Credentials system and role-based access/admin roles (n8n-docs-23, n8n-docs-28, n8n-gh-5), implying credentials can be stored centrally and access governed by roles, but there is no explicit evidence of per-credential sharing controls (e.g., granting specific users/teams access to a specific credential) or credential-usage auditing. Missing for 10: documentation of granular credential-sharing/permissions UI, evidence of team-level credential scoping, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
